cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll agree to equal cake portions if mine accounts for the baking time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Only before labour is included in the calculation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate the spare icing already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Research and development. Please keep the categories separate.
